iptc.Caption-Abstract: FILE--This a recent handout photo of Los Angeles County Sheriff's deputy Jake Kuredjian, a 17-year veteran of the Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department. Kuredjian was shot to death Friday, Aug. 31, 2001, in Santa Clarita, Calif., after officers tried to serve a search warrant on a man who barricaded himself inside his home and opened fire on officers. Officials identified the gunman as 35-year-old James Beck who is suspected of impersonating a U.S. Marshal and stockpiling weapons. (AP Photo/Los Angeles County Sheriff's Dept, HO)
